main_text.p: Natura signo-rum zodiaci explicatur.cognitio est ab illis stellis fixis, quæ constituunt 12. zodiaci signa, quorum etiam præcipua vis deprehenditur, ut & eorum, quæ minori his utrinq; intervallo assistunt, ut Orionis, arcturi, Procyonis, Sirii, &c. Hic igitur maxime inserviunt judiciis Astrologicis dictorum signorum cognitæ differentiæ, quæ scilicet constituant trigonum igneum, quæ aqueum, quæ terreum, & quæ aërium: item quæ æquinoctialia, quæ solstitialia, quæ mobilia, quæ fixa, & quæ communia, quæ masculina, quæ fœminina, quæ rectè ascendant, & quæ obliquè ascendant, quæ fœcunda, quæ sterilia, quæ septentrionalia, quæ meridionalia, quæ præcipientia seu alta, quæ obedientia, quæ ascendentia, quæ descendentia, quæ muta, quæ rationalia, quæ invicem sibi amica, quæ inimica, quæ aliena & non conjuncta, & quæ invicem devincta, quæ sint ingenii, facundiæ & eloquentiæ, &c.

Igneum trigonum constituunt Aries, Leo, & Sagittarius, in cono est Leo, in basis parte dextra Sagittarius, in siniftra Aries: hujus trigoni Domini sunt Sol de die, Jupiter de nocte, particeps autem est Mars.

Aries.Aries primum in zodiaco signum, exaltatio Solis, domus secundaria Martis, naturæ calidæ & siccæ: ex membris humanis habet caput, faciem, oculos, aures, & horum membrorum infirmitates. In eo exaltatur Sol id ingrediens mense Martio, ex austrina mundi plaga septentriones versus se attollens, omnibusq; sublunaribus frigoris rigore fere emortuis vitam & calorem reportans.

Leo.Leo quintum in zodiaco signum, domicilium SOLIS[?], naturæ calidæ & siccæ, habet cor, stomachum, dorsum, latera, costas, horumq; membrorum morbos, ut febres, apostemata, pestilentiam, in hoc nullus Planetarum exaltatur.

page.notes: The catchword "que" at the lower right is printed below the last line and is therefore recorded as a catchword. The faint show-through from the reverse side, visible in the middle of the page, has been left out. "Sol rs" in the Leo paragraph is set in spaced capitals; it is read as SOLIS with the final letters doubtful, marked [?]. The "12." and "9." numerals are copied as printed.
